chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her late 20s wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a long olive-green knit cardigan over a black top
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around 30 with a thick black moustache, wearing a burgundy hoodie with white drawstrings and grey jeans
chars.GIRL: a mischievous 8-year-old girl with noticeably darker skin than the woman, curly black hair in two puffs, wearing a bright pink tracksuit with white side stripes

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. In the doorway of a modest Moroccan apartment in Agadir, WIFE stands holding the hand of GIRL who carries a small backpack, smiling a bit too sweetly; HUSBAND in the foreground looks at the girl with raised eyebrows, curious. Warm evening light, everyday home, playful mood. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. Moroccan living room with low sofas: WIFE sits close to HUSBAND, hands clasped, pleading with big sad eyes; HUSBAND scratches his head, hesitant. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. Moroccan kitchen: HUSBAND stops mid-sip from a glass of mint tea, staring at WIFE suspiciously with one eyebrow up; WIFE looks away nervously, fiddling with her hijab. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. Moroccan living room: WIFE and GIRL stand side by side, HUSBAND leans in comparing their faces, squinting, confused because they look nothing alike. Comic mood. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. Moroccan dining room around a low round table: GIRL glares angrily at HUSBAND with narrowed eyes and crossed arms while he tries to smile awkwardly. Funny tension. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. Moroccan bedroom: GIRL sneakily cuts the sleeve of a burgundy hoodie with scissors next to an open wardrobe, grinning mischievously. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated cartoon style. Moroccan living room: HUSBAND holds up his cut burgundy hoodie, angry and pointing at GIRL; GIRL hides behind WIFE with an innocent face while WIFE defends her with her arm out. Comic family argument. No text.
